citation: Commissati M, et al. Mol Metab 2025;96:102152
protocol: Medically supervised water-only fast, mean 9.8 +/- 3.1 d, then 5.3 d refeeding; blood 06:00-08:00 at baseline, end of fast and end of refeeding
population: 20 volunteers (11 F, 9 M) from a fasting clinic, 52.2 +/- 11.8 y, BMI 28.8 +/- 6.4
note: Fast length varies by person; insulin is only through HOMA-IR; middle-aged, overweight clinic volunteers rather than strictly healthy.
